First response success with visible answer is excluded from unaided eligibility. Denominators distinguish offers, observed responses, repeated rows, final answers and hint-assisted retries. Missing is not automatically wrong.

Hypothetical70four-of-eight allocations per world assume fixed potential outcomes, well-defined treatment/consistency and no interference. Average treated-minus-control contrast equals worldATE; positive world includes contrast-1/2. This is not an actual study or p-value.
Repeated practice items from one learner are not eight independently randomized learners. Source/test text, retrieval scores and a design plan do not establish retention, transfer or causal benefit.
